tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Search the NobleBlocks index of scholarly papers by keyword relevance, with filters.

        Each result has title, authors, year, journal, DOI, citation count, an abstract excerpt,
        a NobleBlocks link and `best_link` (free full text when known, else the DOI/ARK).
        Use get_paper with

tools.name: search_trials
tools.description:
Search clinical trial registrations (ClinicalTrials.gov or WHO ICTRP) held in the NobleBlocks index.

        Each result carries its registry id (`trial_id`, e.g. NCT01234567). Use get_paper with that id
        for the full record.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description:
Full metadata for one paper or trial: authors, journal, volume/issue/pages, identifiers
        (DOI, PMID, arXiv, OpenAlex, trial id, NobleID ARK when confirmed), retraction status,
        open access link, citation count, abstract and links (`links.best` is open access first).

tools.name: get_citing_papers
tools.description:
Papers in the NobleBlocks index that cite this paper, most cited first.
        Citation links are still being loaded, so an empty answer is reported as such, not as 'never cited'.

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Papers this paper cites (its reference list) that are in the NobleBlocks index, most cited first.

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description:
Find researchers by name. Returns name, ORCID iD, OpenAlex id, affiliation and reported counts.
        Use get_author with an ORCID iD for the profile and top papers.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description:
One researcher's public profile by ORCID iD: name, affiliation, topics, reported metrics,
        NobleID when recorded, and their most cited papers in the index.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description:
Format a citation for one paper as BibTeX, RIS or APA 7. The URL is the paper's NobleID ARK
        when it has a confirmed one, else its DOI. DOIs known to be unreliable are left out rather than guessed.

tools.name: cite
tools.description:
Citations for several papers at once, in one format, in the order given. Each entry links
        to the ARK or DOI; failures are listed per identifier instead of failing the whole call.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search scholarly papers and return citable results as {results: [{id, title, url}]}.
        `url` is open access first. Pass an `id` to fetch for the full text record.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Fetch one paper as {id, title, text, url, metadata}. `text` is the abstract plus a formatted
        citation; `url` is open access first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_papers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
